point_b: A deployed LifeRE surface operates through the canonical LifeOS/Universal Overlay shell and a real authenticated browser-extension session proves observe-select-act-verify-receipt-runtime-truth on at least one bounded reversible LifeRE action without ordinary founder clicks; SENTRY Layer B returns PASS from live evidence.
continuation_invariant: Point B false plus exhausted authored slices is BLUEPRINT_EXHAUSTED_RETURN_TO_ARCHITECTURE, never idle-success.

history.archive_policy: Prior/superseded material is provenance only, never executable authority.

steps.title: Re-measure deployed LifeRE and Overlay reality
steps.task: Run/read canonical LifeRE acceptance, real-app E2E, Universal Overlay A-to-Z acceptance, production health, and Layer-B receipt paths. Produce one current-state receipt separating PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, fixture-only, stale, and live-proven evidence. Do not repair in this slice.
steps.acceptance: A current-state receipt exists and every material deployment claim is classified by evidence maturity; no repair or code mutation occurred.

steps.title: Architect and authorize Body-path convergence
steps.task: Using LREUO-001 evidence and current product homes, define the exact convergence boundary between general BodyAdapter real-action path and existing overlay-action-router / extension-drive-bridge path. Name authoritative files/interfaces, allowed delegation direction, fail-closed behavior, forbidden third-pipeline outcome, and exact behavioral acceptance predicates. Builder must not decide 'where appropriate'.
steps.acceptance: A sealed architecture/manufacturing specification exists that lets multiple competent implementers produce materially equivalent convergence without consequential architecture decisions.

steps.title: Implement authorized Body-path convergence
steps.task: Implement only architecture sealed by LREUO-002. Do not add a third control pipeline, broaden scope, change product semantics, or alter acceptance. Preserve fail-closed behavior when no authenticated browser session exists.
steps.acceptance: Implementation matches sealed architecture and deterministic/behavioral tests pass without unauthorized decisions.

steps.title: Architect founder-independent Layer-B proof path
steps.task: Define exact governed browser/extension test path that can establish a real authenticated Layer-B session without ordinary founder clicking. Separate automatable runtime behavior from irreducible one-time human bootstrap. If a true capability boundary exists, specify typed HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER and minimum one-time bootstrap; do not convert bootstrap into recurring founder operation.
steps.acceptance: A deterministic proof architecture exists with exact environment requirements, authentication boundary, expected receipts, timeout/failure behavior, and no hidden ordinary-founder dependency.

steps.title: Implement and prove machine-controlled Layer-B session harness
steps.task: Implement only LREUO-004 sealed proof architecture. Produce a real browser/extension session or emit exact typed capability blocker. Fixture success may support debugging but cannot satisfy live proof.
steps.acceptance: A real session can be machine-established and observed by independent SENTRY, or a truthful HARD_CAPABILITY_BLOCKER proves the irreducible boundary.

steps.title: Prove bounded reversible LifeRE action through Universal Overlay
steps.task: Using a real authenticated session, open canonical LifeRE and exercise one pre-authorized bounded reversible action through Universal Overlay. Capture observation evidence, selected target and explicit rationale, authorization, action receipt, rollback/reversal plan, post-action independent verification, and runtime truth. Builder self-report and fixture-only evidence cannot pass.
steps.acceptance: Real action succeeds, is independently verified, leaves complete receipt chain, and can be safely reversed or is reversed as part of test.

steps.title: Production readiness decision
steps.task: Run real SENTRY Layer B, LifeRE acceptance, production health, security boundary checks, regression tests, and governance evidence review against current release candidate. Do not deploy in this slice. Emit READY_TO_DEPLOY or typed blocker only from current evidence.
steps.acceptance: Independent SENTRY issues READY_TO_DEPLOY with current evidence and no unresolved blocker.

steps.title: Deploy authorized release candidate
steps.task: After LREUO-007 READY_TO_DEPLOY, authorize and invoke canonical deployment mechanism for exact accepted release candidate/hash. Do not modify product code during deployment. Record deployment target, revision/hash, time, and health transition.
steps.acceptance: Exact accepted revision is deployed through canonical path with rollback available and deployment evidence recorded.

steps.title: Post-deploy independent proof and learning closure
steps.task: Independently re-run decisive Layer B / LifeRE production proof against deployed revision, confirm production health, and consolidate all per-failure learning records into reusable governance/blueprint/verifier improvements. Deployment success alone cannot satisfy Point B.
steps.acceptance: Point B is live-proven on deployed revision and every material failure/correction has preserved causal lesson and systemic prevention disposition.

failure_policy.rationale_capture: Capture explicit model output, stated assumptions, tool evidence and receipts. Never request or claim access to private chain-of-thought.

completion_rule: Not complete until exact deployed revision passes live SENTRY Layer B and bounded LifeRE-through-Overlay action in production/current deployed reality, with governance learning captured and no unresolved production blocker.
